panels.title: $server — Status
panels.description: node_exporter reachability

panels.title: CPU Utilization
panels.description: Average CPU utilisation across all cores

panels.title: CPU Usage by Mode
panels.description: Stacked CPU breakdown — iowait+steal indicate external bottlenecks

panels.title: Load Average vs CPU Cores
panels.description: Load above core count = overloaded; watch 15m trend

panels.title: Per-Core CPU Utilization %
panels.description: Hot spots on specific cores indicate single-threaded bottlenecks

panels.title: CPU Frequency per Core
panels.description: Sustained values below max indicate thermal throttling

panels.title: Context Switches / s
panels.description: High values indicate CPU scheduling pressure

panels.title: Memory Utilization
panels.description: MemAvailable accounts for reclaimable cache — more accurate than MemFree

panels.title: Memory Breakdown
panels.description: Linux allocates spare RAM for cache — watch Used, not Free

panels.title: Swap Usage
panels.description: Active swapping indicates memory pressure

panels.title: Disk Space Usage % by Mount
panels.description: Fill level per filesystem

panels.title: Free Disk Space by Mount
panels.description: Available bytes per filesystem

panels.title: Disk I/O Throughput
panels.description: Disk throughput per block device

panels.title: Disk IOPS
panels.description: I/O ops/s — SSD: >50k normal, HDD: >200 warrants attention

panels.title: Disk Average Latency
panels.description: Average I/O latency — HDD>20ms, SSD>5ms, NVMe>1ms warrants investigation

panels.title: Disk I/O Utilization %
panels.description: Disk busy time — sustained >80% is a storage bottleneck

panels.title: Inode Usage % by Mount
panels.description: Inode exhaustion — can run out before disk space

panels.title: Disk Reads/Writes Merged (ops/s)
panels.description: Kernel merges adjacent I/O ops — high merge rate indicates sequential access patterns

panels.title: Network Throughput (RX / TX)
panels.description: RX positive / TX negative mirrored — classic dual-sided bandwidth chart

panels.title: Network Packet Rate
panels.description: Packets per second per interface

panels.title: Network Errors / s
panels.description: Non-zero error rates indicate hardware or cabling issues

panels.title: Packet Drops / s
panels.description: RX drops = buffer overflow; TX drops = queue saturation

panels.title: Process State Trend
panels.description: Running and blocked process counts over time

panels.title: Fork Rate & Thread Count
panels.description: Fork rate and thread count over time

panels.title: File Descriptor Usage Trend
panels.description: Steady FD growth indicates a leak

panels.title: Kernel Interrupts & Context Switches
panels.description: Kernel scheduling activity — useful when diagnosing high system CPU time
